lines: Lee County is located in north central Illinois. Our rural setting includes the beautiful Rock River valley, bountiful fields of agriculture, industry, and peaceful hometowns. Members of the Lee County Democrats are as diverse in experiences as our county’s varied resources. But, we are unified in our values. Opportunity and equal rights for all citizens are the cornerstone of Democratic beliefs.

The Lee County Democratic Party is the party of the people. We are committed to preserving the Democratic Party’s principles that support the freedoms and rights of all American citizens with zero tolerance for exclusion or discrimination. We welcome Lee County residents of every race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, economic status, and condition. We are the Party of working families, and we are committed to working together on behalf of Lee County’s working class.
To support and promote the growth and development of the Democratic Party and its principles.
To actively seek and support Democratic candidates for public office, including candidates for nonpartisan offices.
To inform voters of relevant issues and candidates’ positions on those issues.
To perform such election functions as required by law.
To raise funds for the above purposes.

The Get Out the Vote/Party Building Committee meets once a month to work on content for the newsletter, the website, and to generate ideas for growing our membership and volunteer base. We invite all who are interested to join our meetings or to share ideas with committee members. Like so many things, our activities have been limited due to the pandemic but we look forward to a time when we can begin to plan in person gatherings. Volunteers are critical to the success of the Lee County Democratic Party organization. We hope you will find an activity in the Party for your special skills and talents.

The Fundraising Committee plans and organizes all fundraising events. Funds are used to support the candidates, pay for an office during election seasons, and promote future fundraising efforts. The results of our efforts are especially rewarding when Democratic candidates and values are promoted throughout the county.
To help with fundraising, you can take part in a fundraising event, join the committee or donate!

A fourth-generation farmer, Fritts advocates for pro-ag legislation, repeal of soft-on-crime policies like the SAFE-T Act, increased support for law enforcement, keeping rural hospitals open, and pro-business initiatives to retain state jobs.

lines: Lee County Republican Precinct Committee Persons

Lee County IL is looking for some strong conservative individuals with leadership qualities to campaign for elected offices in order to take the Republican message to every American, grow the party, promote election integrity, and elect Republicans up and down the ballot. The principles of the Republican Party recognize the God-given liberties while promoting opportunity for every American.

A Lee County Republican precinct committee person is a member of the Republican Party’s Central Committee and is responsible for voter education, engagement, and voter turnout within their precincts. In addition to voter engagement, the Precinct Committee is responsible for candidate recommendation and slating. Candidate recommendations are needed when a seat, such as one on the county board, is vacated and the prior board-member was a Republican. The PCs from the county board district vote to recommend a replacement to the board chair. The chair is not obligated to follow that recommendation but is always encouraged.
